chromium.label: release
chromium.labelText: release protocol (plan §9): branded stable browser, headed, declared target hardware, ≥21 warm pairs, BCa paired intervals
chromium.automation: Playwright 1.64.1 driving branded stable Google Chrome, headed: flatpak run com.google.Chrome (CDP)

jsHeap.label: Main-thread V8 JS heap used (CDP Performance.getMetrics JSHeapUsedSize), polled every 50 ms from navigation to the stable frame; excludes worker heaps and ArrayBuffer backing stores; a lower bound on the true peak

retained.label: performance.measureUserAgentSpecificMemory() total after the stable frame, in a cross-origin-isolated copy of the same build (includes same-origin workers and buffers); a post-render snapshot, not the peak during computation
